stock.description: REPT BATTERO Energy Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of advanced lithium-ion battery products. The company's extensive product range includes cells, modules, and complete battery packs designed for electric vehicles (EVs) and energy storage systems (ESS), alongside ESS battery boxes, racks, and comprehensive energy storage containers. Additionally, it provides specialized aluminum shell processing and machining services. Its sophisticated battery solutions are widely utilized in diverse applications, powering various types of vehicles such as passenger cars, commercial fleets, specialized transport, forklift trucks, unmanned sweepers, low-speed vehicles, and construction machinery. Furthermore, these solutions serve a broad spectrum of energy storage scenarios, encompassing residential, large-scale industrial, and various commercial installations. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, the company was formerly known as REPT Energy Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name in April 2022. REPT BATTERO Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Yongqing Technology Co. Ltd.
